title: Tent of meeting at Shiloh
english: [[All the congregation gathers at Shiloh — the tent of meeting there >> Bible:Joshua 18:1]]. Shiloh (“peace”) is the place of lots. The church in Christ’s peace receives spiritual lots.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Seven tribes still without portion
english: [[Seven tribes still without portion >> Bible:Joshua 18:2]]. Jesus: [[How long will you be slack? Send men to map the land >> Bible:Joshua 18:3-4]]. Sloth is rebuked.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
